mapper.sql: SELECT a.*, GROUP_CONCAT(s.student_name ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR '、') AS student_name, GROUP_CONCAT(s.id ORDER BY r.id) AS student_ids FROM attachment a LEFT JOIN attachment_student r ON r.attachment_id = a.id AND r.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN student s ON s.id = r.student_id AND s.user_id = r.user_id GROUP BY a.id, a.user_id, a.file_name, a.file_path, a.file_size, a.mime_type, a.created_at
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, GROUP_CONCAT(s.student_name ORDER BY r2.id SEPARATOR '、') AS student_name FROM attachment a INNER JOIN attachment_student r ON r.attachment_id = a.id AND r.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN attachment_student r2 ON r2.attachment_id = a.id AND r2.user_id = a.user_id LEFT JOIN student s ON s.id = r2.student_id AND s.user_id = r2.user_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND r.student_id = #{studentId} GROUP BY a.id, a.user_id, a.file_name, a.file_path, a.file_size, a.mime_type, a.created_at ORDER BY a.id DESC

SELECT a2.*, GROUP_CONCAT(s.student_name ORDER BY r.id SEPARATOR '、') AS student_name, GROUP_CONCAT(s.id ORDER BY r.id) AS student_ids FROM ( SELECT a.id FROM attachment a
ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset} ) p INNER JOIN attachment a2 ON a2.id = p.id LEFT JOIN attachment_student r ON r.attachment_id = a2.id AND r.user_id = a2.user_id LEFT JOIN student s ON s.id = r.student_id AND s.user_id = r.user_id GROUP BY a2.id ORDER BY a2.id DESC
SELECT * FROM attachment WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attachment(user_id, file_name, file_path, file_size, mime_type) VALUES(#{userId}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{mimeType})
INSERT IGNORE INTO attachment_student(user_id, attachment_id, student_id) VALUES(#{userId}, #{attachmentId}, #{studentId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachment_student WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND attachment_id = #{attachmentId} AND student_id = #{studentId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM attachment WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
DELETE FROM attachment_student WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND attachment_id = #{attachmentId}
